title: Fun way to spend the day
text: We had such a fab time thank you so much you were great for keeping in touch - even though we were unavoidably late...you also sorted out birthday cake for my son's birthday. It was great to do both experiences of the segway and the sail as it gave us a real chance to have some really good fun. I would recommend this as a fun easy activity where all of the thinking is done for you.
author: Draya71
